title: Login loop and ride/payment failures lock users out of Uber app
description: Users report being unexpectedly logged out at urgent times and getting stuck in a login loop on relogin ("app log out . and while relogin it go on loop but do not login"). Others cannot accept payment cards, are overcharged, or lose contact with assigned drivers, blocking the core ride-hailing flow.
affected_component: Authentication / ride-booking session and payment
steps_to_reproduce: Open the Uber app on a phone where the user is signed in
Trigger a session expiration (or wait until the app silently logs the user out)
Attempt to log back in with existing credentials
Observe the login screen reload repeatedly without completing authentication
Try to add or use a saved payment card to book a ride
expected_behavior: Users remain signed in across sessions, can re-authenticate in a single attempt, and can book/pay for a ride without the app rejecting valid cards.
actual_behavior: App silently logs users out, the relogin screen loops indefinitely, payment cards are rejected, and the help menu only returns canned responses for unrelated issues.

title: Lock-screen ads override alarms and block phone unlock
description: Users report that the app injects unsolicited ads and screensavers onto the lock screen, "totally screw up your alarm clock" and forcing users to dismiss ads before they can unlock the device. AppLock functionality also reportedly fails ("<app> lock doesn't work").
affected_component: Lock screen / AppLock and notification surface
steps_to_reproduce: Install the app and grant lock-screen / overlay permissions
Lock the device and wait for an alarm or notification to fire
Observe an ad or screensaver covering the lock screen
Attempt to dismiss the ad and unlock the phone
Confirm whether the alarm sounded or was suppressed by the overlay
expected_behavior: The app must not display ads on the lock screen, must never suppress system alarms, and AppLock must reliably lock selected apps.
actual_behavior: Lock-screen ads appear without consent, alarms are disrupted, and AppLock intermittently fails to lock protected apps.

title: Gallery import shows blank thumbnails and blocks save after update
description: After a recent update, users cannot pick photos from the gallery (thumbnails appear as "blank square block"), edits fail to save, and the editor refuses to work offline ("if i'm not connect to the internet it won't let me do anything"). Multiple users tried reinstalling without resolution.
affected_component: Photo editor: gallery picker / save pipeline
steps_to_reproduce: Update the app to the latest version
Open the editor and tap the gallery / add-photo picker
Select an image whose thumbnail renders as a blank square
Make any edit and tap Save
Observe that no save dialog or destination folder is offered
expected_behavior: Gallery thumbnails render correctly, the user can select a photo offline, and Save offers a folder choice and writes the file to local storage.
actual_behavior: Thumbnails show blank squares, photo selection fails, the save action either errors or silently does nothing, and offline editing is blocked.

title: Login fails on new device; account registration loops on email/phone in use
description: Users cannot sign in to existing accounts after switching devices ("cannot login with my old username on new phone") and the registration flow loops back to the start while reporting that the email/phone is already in use. Per-device account state is also reset, forcing re-setup of content and magazine lists.
affected_component: Authentication: login, registration, account recovery
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in successfully on Device A and create some content/preferences
Install the app on Device B and tap Log In with the same credentials
Observe a generic "unable to log in" error or rejection
Tap Register and enter the same email/phone
Observe "already in use" error and the flow returning to the start
expected_behavior: Existing credentials should authenticate on any device; registration should detect existing accounts and route the user to login or password recovery rather than looping.
actual_behavior: Login is rejected on new devices, registration loops back to the beginning, content settings are wiped per-device, and there is no working customer support path.

title: News reader: keyboard hides comment box, frequent crashes, no uninstall
description: On Samsung Tab S2 the on-screen keyboard covers the comment area, the article reader crashes "every time i use it", and the app is preinstalled bloatware that users cannot remove ("unable to uninstall and clog my news fee with bias fake news"). Headline page is gated behind a slow loading screen.
affected_component: News reader: article view, comment input, app installation
steps_to_reproduce: Open a news article on a tablet (e.g., Samsung Tab S2)
Tap the comment field and try to type a comment
Observe the keyboard covers the comment text box
Navigate between articles repeatedly until a crash occurs
Try to uninstall the app from device settings
expected_behavior: Comment box stays visible above the keyboard, the reader does not crash on routine navigation, and the app is uninstallable like any user-facing app.
actual_behavior: Keyboard occludes the comment area, crashes occur on most sessions, headlines load slowly, and the app cannot be removed by the user.

title: Video editor cannot import or export edited videos
description: Users get "file you choose may have be destroy" when importing video, trim does not honor the input start time, and exporting fails silently in any format ("it wouldn't export ... no notification come up just export about <digit> then screen just go back to the main page"). Edited project ends up stuck in drafts.
affected_component: Video editor: media import, trim, and export pipeline
steps_to_reproduce: Open the video editor and tap Add / Import video
Select a video from the device gallery
Apply a trim with a specific start timestamp and any other edit
Tap Export and choose any format/destination
Observe export progress and resulting file
expected_behavior: Selected videos import without corruption errors, trim respects the user-specified start time, and export completes with a saved output file and a clear success/failure notification.
actual_behavior: Imports fail with a generic "file may be destroyed" error, trim ignores the chosen start time, and export aborts around halfway with no notification, leaving the project as a draft.

title: Edited photos saved at very low resolution and appear pixelated
description: After editing, exported images shrink from megabytes to "<digit> to 40kb" and look pixelated/blurred ("the clarity of the photo start to get worse and worse after each update"). The regression appeared after recent updates and is especially visible when adding overlays or magic effects.
affected_component: Photo editor: export / save resolution pipeline
steps_to_reproduce: Open a high-resolution photo (multi-megabyte) in the editor
Apply an edit such as adding an overlay or magic effect
Tap Save / Export with default settings
Locate the exported file in the gallery
Compare file size and visible sharpness to the source image
expected_behavior: Exported images preserve the source resolution and visual clarity, with file size proportional to the original.
actual_behavior: Saved files drop to roughly 20-40 KB with visible pixelation and blur, especially around added effects.

title: Magic Effect tool fails with "something went wrong" / server busy
description: Tapping Magic Effect throws a generic "something go wrong" error or hangs with "server busy"; on some devices (e.g., Samsung A3) the button is missing entirely or the effect download fails. Users have raised repeated tickets without resolution.
affected_component: Photo editor: Magic Effect feature and its server-side dependency
steps_to_reproduce: Open a photo in the editor
Tap the Magic Effect tool
Wait for the effect picker / download to complete
Select any magic effect
Observe the error toast or hang
expected_behavior: Magic Effect loads available effects, applies the selected effect within a few seconds, and surfaces a specific error if the network/server fails.
actual_behavior: The feature throws "something went wrong", reports "server busy", hangs indefinitely, or the Magic Effect button is absent on some devices.

title: Notifications cannot be disabled and badge count never clears
description: Even after toggling all push-notification options off, users still receive cricket-score and other promotional pushes ("suddenly start receive push notification again even though i turn off all push notification in the setting"). The notification badge on the app icon also persists after all messages have been read.
affected_component: Notification settings and badge / unread-count logic
steps_to_reproduce: Open the app and go to Settings > Notifications
Disable all notification categories (push, peek, autodownload, etc.)
Close the app and wait for a server-side notification window
Observe push notifications still arriving
Read all messages and check the launcher icon badge
expected_behavior: When the user disables a notification category it stays disabled, and the launcher badge clears once all messages are read.
actual_behavior: Disabled notifications silently re-enable themselves, peek and auto-download still fire, and the unread badge remains on the icon after the inbox is cleared.

title: App cannot be uninstalled and reinstalls itself after system updates
description: Users cannot uninstall the app via standard means ("every time i try uninstalling this <app> it won't let me") and report that it returns after each system update, consuming storage and blocking installation of other apps. Reviews are heavily 1-star (826/961).
affected_component: App installation / uninstallation and system-app permissions
steps_to_reproduce: Open device Settings > Apps and locate the app
Tap Uninstall
Confirm whether the option is greyed out or fails
Allow the OS to perform a system update
Re-check whether the app has reappeared
expected_behavior: Users can uninstall the app the same way as any other user-facing application, and it does not silently reinstall after OS updates.
actual_behavior: Uninstall is blocked or reverted, the app returns after system updates, and it occupies storage that the user cannot reclaim.

title: Antivirus stops detecting threats after update; reinstalls itself
description: Following the latest update the antivirus engine "isn't respond" and fails to detect viruses, while users report the app itself reinstalls without consent and triggers loud alarm tones ("emit a loud tone and do not <app> off until i shut down the app"). Some attribute device damage to the app.
affected_component: Antivirus scan engine / self-update and alert behavior
steps_to_reproduce: Update the antivirus app to the latest version
Run a full device scan
Observe whether known suspicious files are detected
Try to uninstall the app and complete a factory-style reset
Reconnect to the internet and check whether the app reappears
expected_behavior: The scan engine reliably identifies known threats, alerts use system-standard volume, and the app stays uninstalled until the user reinstalls it.
actual_behavior: Scans return no results or freeze, full-volume alert tones cannot be silenced from inside the app, and the app reinstalls itself after uninstall.

title: App fails to launch on Android Nougat 7.x and recent OS updates
description: Users on Android 7.0/7.1 report the app no longer works ("not work on <app> nougat <digit>.<digit>") and that data directory is set read-only after the OS upgrade with no in-app guidance. The app does not support recent Android updates and offers only over-complicated workarounds.
affected_component: OS compatibility layer / storage permissions on Android 7.x+
steps_to_reproduce: Install the app on a device running Android 7.0 or 7.1
Launch the app
Attempt the primary action (e.g., scan, edit, browse)
Observe the error "data directory is read-only" or a silent failure
Check in-app help for OS-upgrade guidance
expected_behavior: The app launches and functions on currently supported Android versions, requests storage permissions correctly, and provides clear guidance when an OS change requires migration.
actual_behavior: App fails to start or operate on Android 7.x, surfaces a cryptic read-only data-directory error, and offers no actionable in-app help.

title: Purchased stickers, frames, and clipart disappear or fail to preview
description: Users have to repeatedly redownload purchased stickers, frames, and backgrounds ("i have to download the background sticker and many more again and again"). Recently the clip-art preview shows only a loading spinner and saved cut-outs are no longer accessible.
affected_component: In-app purchase library: stickers, clipart, frames, backgrounds
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in to an account with previously purchased sticker/frame packs
Open the editor and navigate to the clipart or sticker library
Attempt to preview a pack
Open a previously saved cutout from the user's library
Re-download the pack and verify whether it persists across app restarts
expected_behavior: Purchased and saved assets remain available across sessions and devices, previews load promptly, and there is a clear way to restore purchases.
actual_behavior: Asset packs must be redownloaded repeatedly, previews show only a loading icon, and saved cutouts are no longer accessible.

title: Latest update degrades UI, performance, and key features vs. old version
description: Users report broad regressions after the latest update: "too many problem with the latest update . use to be better", slow loading, missing news refresh, and clone-tool selection bugs. A non-trivial subset explicitly asks to revert to the old version.
affected_component: App-wide regressions in latest release
steps_to_reproduce: Note baseline behavior on the previous app version
Update to the latest release
Reopen the app and exercise primary flows (browse, edit, refresh)
Observe slowdowns, missing data, or broken tools (e.g., clone tool)
Compare against the previous version's behavior
expected_behavior: New releases preserve performance and feature parity with the prior version unless changes are explicitly documented in release notes.
actual_behavior: Multiple flows are slower, news no longer refreshes, the clone tool mis-selects points, and overall UX is perceived as worse than the previous build.

title: UC Browser silently downloads/installs other apps and can't be disabled
description: Users report UC Browser "behave like an addware", silently downloading and installing other apps without permission and reinstalling itself after a factory reset ("download and install itself as soon as i connect to internet"). Other sites flag the browser as having security problems, and UC News cannot be disabled.
affected_component: UC Browser core: silent downloads, UC News integration, security posture
steps_to_reproduce: Install UC Browser on a clean device and connect to the internet
Use the browser normally for a few sessions
Inspect the device app list for unrequested third-party installs
Try to disable or remove UC News from the homepage
Uninstall UC Browser, reset, and reconnect to the internet
expected_behavior: The browser must not download or install third-party apps without explicit user consent, must let users disable UC News, and must stay uninstalled once removed.
actual_behavior: Other apps are pushed to the device silently, UC News cannot be removed from the homepage, refresh fails with "need internet connection", and the app reinstalls itself after factory reset.

title: App crashes on launch with hardware-acceleration error; reinstall does not help
description: Users repeatedly cannot open the app: "it keep crash so i can't get into the app or even use it". Crashes sometimes mention hardware acceleration and persist through reinstall. In some cases launching another app on top causes the screen to go black or loop.
affected_component: App startup / rendering pipeline (hardware acceleration path)
steps_to_reproduce: Install the app on the affected device
Tap the app icon to launch
Wait through the splash / first-frame render
Observe the immediate crash, sometimes with a hardware-acceleration message
Uninstall, reboot, reinstall, and retry
expected_behavior: The app launches reliably on supported devices and degrades gracefully if hardware acceleration is unavailable.
actual_behavior: App crashes on or shortly after launch, repeats across sessions, persists after reinstall, and can leave the screen black on related devices.

title: App reports "connection failed" on healthy Wi-Fi / mobile data
description: Users on active Wi-Fi or mobile data are blocked by "connection fail", "network error", or "you're offline" messages despite other apps working ("won't connect even with an active wifi connection"). The latest update reportedly removed offline functionality entirely.
affected_component: Network connectivity layer / online-state detection
steps_to_reproduce: Confirm that the device has working internet (via browser or another app)
Open the affected app over Wi-Fi
Trigger any networked feature (login, magic effect, search, etc.)
Observe the "connection failed" / "network error" / "offline" message
Switch to mobile data and retry
expected_behavior: Whenever the device has working internet, the app's connectivity check succeeds and online features work; offline-capable flows continue to work without internet.
actual_behavior: App incorrectly reports the device as offline on healthy Wi-Fi/mobile networks and blocks all online flows; some flows that previously worked offline now require connectivity.

title: App crashes repeatedly on open and after first use
description: Users report "it keep crash every time i try to open it" and "crash after try it once . cannot open it since". Crashes occur on routine launch, and one user reports it crashing while attempting to change a gas bottle at night, blocking the core utility.
affected_component: App startup and main session lifecycle
steps_to_reproduce: Install the app and grant any required permissions
Open the app and use the primary feature once
Close the app and reopen it
Observe crash on second launch
Repeat across sessions to confirm it is not a one-off
expected_behavior: App opens reliably across sessions and survives normal interaction without crashing.
actual_behavior: App crashes on subsequent launches, sometimes mid-task, with no recovery beyond reinstall.

title: Pages fail to load or load extremely slowly in UC Browser
description: Users report sites do not open in UC ("the site u hve gven be nt open in my uc"), pages don't load properly, content does not render, and Facebook in particular is very slow to load. New installs hang on a perpetual loading state.
affected_component: Browser page-loading / rendering engine
steps_to_reproduce: Install or open UC Browser
Navigate to a typical site such as facebook.com or a user-saved URL
Wait for the page to render
Observe blank page, perpetual loading, or partially rendered content
Retry on a different network and confirm reproducibility
expected_behavior: Standard websites load fully and within a few seconds on healthy networks.
actual_behavior: Pages stay on the loading indicator, render partially, or never display; Facebook in particular takes excessive time.

title: Downloads stall, fluctuate, or never start
description: Users report downloads not progressing or oscillating in size ("download start fluctuate . like 30mb 40mb . then after 40mb again show 30mb"). Some downloads never begin, .pkg files cannot be downloaded, and the progress UI fails to update.
affected_component: Download manager: progress tracking and resume logic
steps_to_reproduce: Start a download of any sizable file
Observe the progress UI
Wait for the download to complete or stall
If progress oscillates (decreases then increases), note the behavior
Try downloading a .pkg or other less-common file type
expected_behavior: Download progress increases monotonically toward 100%, the manager shows accurate state, and supported file types complete reliably.
actual_behavior: Downloads stall, progress numbers go backwards, some files never start, and the UI does not reflect the true transfer state.

title: Junk-file cleaner reports inflated and inconsistent free-space gains
description: Users report Clean Master / junk cleaner inflates results ("if your <app> junk file be 200mb on that time <digit> <app> show 450mb"), nags about full memory at low utilization, and after the update the "exclusive clean" option for the junk extension disappeared. App also crashes during clean operations.
affected_component: Junk-file scanner: size calculation and exclusive-clean option
steps_to_reproduce: Open the cleaner and run a junk-file scan
Note the reported junk size
Cross-check against actual disk usage in device settings
Verify whether "exclusive clean" appears for the junk extension
Run repeated cleans and watch for crashes / "unexpectedly stopped"
expected_behavior: Reported junk size matches an independent measurement of actual reclaimable space, the exclusive-clean option remains available, and clean operations complete without crashes.
actual_behavior: Cleaner over-reports junk size by 2x or more, the exclusive-clean option is missing post-update, and the app crashes during scans.

title: Music app fails to play songs and skips tracks without playing
description: Users cannot play any songs ("i can't get any of the song to play nor can i download any of them"), specific downloaded tracks fail to play while others work, radios skip through dozens of tracks without playing, and playback errors return "couldn't play the track you requested".
affected_component: Music playback engine and download/library handling
steps_to_reproduce: Open the music app and search for any song or artist
Tap Play on a streaming track
Observe whether playback starts or errors
Start a radio station and watch track behavior
Try a previously downloaded track from the offline library
expected_behavior: Selected tracks play immediately, radios advance only on user skip or song completion, and downloaded tracks remain playable offline.
actual_behavior: Tracks fail to start or stop after one song, radios skip dozens of tracks without playing, and playback returns generic "couldn't play" errors.

title: Core functionality intermittently broken: "it refuse to work"
description: Cluster of low-detail one-star reviews reporting that the app simply does not work ("it refuse to work", "can't work", "doesn't work properly now"). Reviews lack specifics but converge on a hard functional regression. Quality concern: theme is generic; recommend follow-up triage to attach specific repro steps.
affected_component: App-wide functional reliability (unspecified core feature)
steps_to_reproduce: Install the latest version of the app
Attempt the app's primary advertised function
Observe that the action fails with no specific error
Retry across app restarts and reinstalls
Capture device, OS, and exact tap sequence for triage
expected_behavior: The app's primary function works as advertised on supported devices.
actual_behavior: Core feature silently fails; users describe the app as non-functional but do not consistently report a single error path.

title: Editor crashes mid-session and loses unsaved work; persistent rate-app nag
description: Users report the app crashes after long edit sessions and loses work ("app crash after i spend <digit> hour on a detail edit and i lose my work"), repeatedly nags for a rating even after the user already rated it, and address-input regressions broke navigation flows. Score nag persists "every day" and is described as "irritate and rude".
affected_component: Editor session autosave and rating-prompt frequency control
steps_to_reproduce: Open the app and start a long editing session (1+ hour)
Make many sequential edits without saving
Wait for or trigger the crash
Reopen the app and check for autosave / draft recovery
Separately, after submitting an in-app rating, wait one day and reopen the app
expected_behavior: Long editor sessions are autosaved so a crash does not lose work, and the rating prompt does not reappear after the user has already rated the app.
actual_behavior: Mid-session crashes discard hours of work with no autosave, and the rate-app prompt continues to appear daily after a rating has been submitted.

title: App cannot be uninstalled by the user
description: Users report the app appeared on their device unexpectedly and the standard uninstall flow does not work ("i dont know how it get instal now i can't uninstall it", "don't use it and can't uninstall it"). 466 of 544 reviews are 1-star, indicating a near-uniform user experience.
affected_component: Uninstall flow / system-app status
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the app in device Settings > Apps
Tap Uninstall
Observe whether the option is unavailable, disabled, or fails silently
Try the long-press uninstall gesture from the launcher
Try a third-party uninstaller and observe whether it succeeds
expected_behavior: The app must offer a working uninstall path for any user who did not intentionally install it.
actual_behavior: Uninstall is unavailable or fails, leaving the app permanently on the device.

title: Messages and calls only deliver when the app is open in the foreground
description: Users only receive messages and calls when the app is open ("i never receive msg or call in normal way i always need to <app> open the app"), outgoing messages aren't delivered, online status sticks after closing, and recent updates broke calling so only text works ("only able to send text now").
affected_component: Background messaging / push delivery and VoIP calling
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in on the affected device
Close the app fully (not just background) and lock the screen
From another device, send a message and place a call to the user
Observe whether notifications arrive while the app is closed
Open the app and check whether the queued messages then appear
expected_behavior: Messages and calls are delivered in real time even when the app is in background or closed; outbound messages reach recipients and online status reflects actual presence.
actual_behavior: Messages/calls arrive only when the app is opened in the foreground, outgoing messages fail to deliver, and online status remains green after the app is closed.

title: Launcher creates extra home screens, loses app names, and forgets default
description: Launcher reportedly auto-creates a new home screen for each newly installed app ("any newly instal <app> would create a new home screen"), the app drawer cannot be arranged, app icons disappear after settings tweaks, and the OS forgets the launcher choice after every reboot ("take ten year to <app> back to <app> launcher set").
affected_component: Home-screen / app-drawer management and default-launcher persistence
steps_to_reproduce: Set the affected launcher as the device default
Install a new app from Play Store and return to home
Observe a new home screen page being created automatically
Reboot the device
Check whether the launcher choice is remembered or has reverted
expected_behavior: Newly installed apps go to an existing free slot, the app drawer supports user-defined ordering, app names persist, and the default-launcher choice survives reboots.
actual_behavior: Each install spawns a new home page, drawer ordering is unmodifiable, app names occasionally vanish, and the OS prompts for default launcher after every reboot.

title: Installing the app causes the entire phone to lag and run slowly
description: Users report that installing the app makes their phone slow and laggy across the system ("this <app> be very laggy for my phone", "i install this <app> and then suddenly my fone be go slow"). Tablets in particular shut down randomly during sessions, and animation feedback after taps lags by ~1 second.
affected_component: App runtime / background services impacting device-wide performance
steps_to_reproduce: Benchmark device responsiveness before installing the app
Install the app and grant default permissions
Use other apps and the launcher for several minutes
On tablets, run a long session inside the app
Compare touch-to-response latency and overall system smoothness
expected_behavior: App should not noticeably degrade overall system performance; touch interactions inside the app respond within standard latency budgets.
actual_behavior: Phones become slow after installation, tablets shut down mid-session, and tap animations respond a second after the input.

title: Generic post-update bug reports requesting fixes
description: Cluster of short low-detail reviews asking for bug fixes ("fix bug please", "a few bug to fix and it might be the best", "thnx for fix the issue"). Mix of pre- and post-fix comments. Quality concern: theme is generic feedback rather than a single isolable defect; treat as backlog hygiene.
affected_component: General app stability / release-quality backlog
steps_to_reproduce: Triage individual reviews in this cluster for specific repro details
Group by app version and device
Reproduce on the most-recently-released build
Cross-reference with crash analytics and other clusters
File specific bugs against affected components
expected_behavior: Each release ships with high stability and addresses outstanding bug reports.
actual_behavior: Users report unspecified residual bugs without enough detail to isolate a single defect.

title: App stops working after OS update; in-app update prompt is misleading
description: Users report the app no longer works after the latest OS update ("do not work at all since the update for <app>"). The in-app prompt says an update is required while the Play Store reports no update available ("i think the update notification be an ad . i can't tell"), leaving users stuck.
affected_component: App-update detection and OS-compatibility handling
steps_to_reproduce: Install the app on a device running an older OS where it works
Allow the OS to update to the latest supported version
Reopen the app
Observe failure and the in-app "please update" prompt
Open Play Store / app store and check whether an update is actually available
expected_behavior: After an OS update the app continues to work, or the in-app prompt links to a real, available app update.
actual_behavior: App breaks after OS updates, in-app prompts ask for updates that the store does not have, and users have no path forward.

title: Add fare estimate, driver feedback, and Uber Pool improvements
description: Riders ask for the fare-estimate feature back ("now i couldn't estimate how much fare i should pay . please bring back the feature"), the ability to rate or report drivers who cancel/no-show, accurate ETA pins, refunds for cancelled trips, and improvements to Uber Pool. Trip planning, credit-card removal, and name editing are also called out as poor.
affected_component: Ride-booking flow: fare estimation, driver feedback, account management, Pool
user_story: As a rider, I want to see an upfront fare estimate, rate or report drivers who cancel on me, and edit my account/payment details easily, so that I can make informed booking decisions and resolve issues without contacting support.
acceptance_criteria: Rider sees a fare estimate (range and currency) before confirming a ride
Rider can submit feedback for a driver who cancels or no-shows, even if the trip never started
Rider can delete a saved credit card and edit name fields from the account settings in <= 3 taps
Uber Pool trips surface estimated additional time and number of co-riders before booking
Users receive a clear status and refund path for trips charged after driver cancellation

title: Reduce ad volume; remove full-screen and lock-screen ads
description: Users describe ads as "a pain in the neck" and ask to cut full-screen ads entirely ("need to cut out full screen ads altogether"). Some report the app silently changing the lock screen and turning ad-related features on by default. They request fewer, less obtrusive ads or a clean default state.
affected_component: Ad-monetization layer and default opt-in settings
user_story: As a free-tier user, I want fewer and less intrusive ads with no full-screen or lock-screen placements by default, so that the app remains usable without disrupting my phone.
acceptance_criteria: Full-screen interstitial ads are removed or capped at no more than once per session
Lock-screen ads and lock-screen modifications are off by default and require explicit opt-in
An always-available paid or rewarded option to disable ads is documented in settings
No ad surface fires during emergency-related flows
Frequency caps are documented and respected per session

title: Add fast-forward, subtitles, and original-audio removal in video editor
description: Users request "fast forward and fast backward button in video player", subtitle-file import, next/previous track buttons, the ability to remove the original sound from a video, longer 1-minute+ output (current cap drops it to 30s), and matching photo-slideshow duration to a song's length.
affected_component: Video editor / player: playback controls, audio handling, duration limits
user_story: As a video creator, I want playback controls (fast-forward, next/previous), subtitle import, original-audio removal, and matching slideshow length to my chosen music, so that I can produce richer videos without external tools.
acceptance_criteria: Player exposes 5/10s fast-forward and rewind, plus next/previous track buttons
Editor accepts standard subtitle files (.srt) and renders them on the timeline
User can mute or remove the original audio track of a clip in one tap
Video duration is no longer truncated to 30s for clips longer than 1 minute
Slideshows can auto-extend so total duration matches the selected music track

title: Customizable news feed with source filtering and clickbait controls
description: Users want to filter or block sources from their feed ("i only <app> there be a way to filter out some source", "please stop add everything back to my source list"), reduce clickbait and unaccredited articles, and get back the lighter pre-update interface. Niche topics (rugby league, baseball) are under-served.
affected_component: News feed customization and source-management settings
user_story: As a news reader, I want to permanently remove sources I distrust and surface niche topics I follow, so that my feed reflects my actual interests instead of clickbait.
acceptance_criteria: Users can block specific publishers and the block persists across app sessions and updates
A clickbait / low-quality filter is available and clearly labelled in settings
Niche topics (e.g., rugby league, baseball) can be added as first-class feed sources
Source list is not silently re-populated by the app after a user removes items
Per-publisher quality flags can be reported by users and feed back into the ranking

title: General request: simplify UX, add options, improve speed
description: Generic improvement requests: "could be better", "u guy have to improve on the speed", "it have become more complicate now a day . earlier it be simple beautiful handy". Users want simpler flows, more configuration options, and faster performance, but do not converge on a single feature. Quality concern: very generic theme.
affected_component: App-wide UX / configurability backlog
user_story: As a long-time user, I want the app to remain simple and fast while still offering enough customization, so that I retain the lightweight feel I originally liked.
acceptance_criteria: A simplification pass reduces taps required for the top 3 user flows by at least 25%
Settings expose at least 3 commonly-requested toggles (e.g., layout density, default tools, notifications)
Cold-start time is benchmarked and improves measurably vs. the previous release
Onboarding for advanced features does not interrupt simple, fast workflows
Generic improvement-request reviews drop in subsequent release cycles

title: Preserve photo resolution; offer HD export at original megapixels
description: Users want HD-preserving export ("max image size be <digit> mega pixel . please upgrade", "give option that be clearity just like photoshop"), PNG support, and want the older quality back ("in the older version of <app> the edit photo size be ... megabyte"). Sister concern to bug cluster c_00018 but framed as a capability gap.
affected_component: Photo editor: export resolution / format options
user_story: As a photo editor, I want a high-resolution export option that preserves the source megapixels and supports PNG, so that my edited photos are publication-ready.
acceptance_criteria: User can choose export resolution up to the source image's native megapixels
PNG is offered as an export format alongside JPEG
Magic-effect outputs do not down-sample the working image
Default export quality matches or exceeds the prior release's output
Exported file size is in the same order of magnitude as the source for high-quality settings

title: Allow uninstalling the bundled app and clean up shortcut shortcuts
description: Users want the option to uninstall the preinstalled app ("still wait for the option to be able to uninstall this piece of crap"), removal of the bundled app booster that kills other apps, and cleanup of links containing malware/junk. Heavy 1-star skew indicates strong user demand. Quality concern: overlaps with bug cluster c_00048 / c_00044 but framed as a feature ask.
affected_component: Bundled-app uninstall path and link/shortcut cleanup
user_story: As a phone owner, I want to uninstall this preinstalled app and remove its bundled shortcuts, so that I am not forced to keep software I never chose to install.
acceptance_criteria: The app exposes a working Uninstall option in device settings on all OEM bundles
All bundled shortcuts (booster, deep links) can be removed independently of the main app
Promoted links flagged as malware are removed from in-app surfaces
An option exists to disable the app fully if uninstall is not technically possible
The default install does not enable bundled features without user consent

title: Add more fonts, custom font import, and text/typography options
description: Users request more font styles, free font/effect/theme packs each update, custom font import from SD card ("i use several urdu font in text tool before ! now there be no section to use personal sd card font"), typographic portraits, dark/night theme, and an exit button. Reviews skew positive (4-5 star), framing this as a capability gap.
affected_component: Text / typography toolset in the editor
user_story: As a designer-user, I want a richer font library, custom font import, and typographic templates, so that my text overlays look professional without leaving the app.
acceptance_criteria: Font library is expanded by at least 25 free fonts including non-Latin scripts
User can import custom fonts from device storage / SD card
Typographic portrait template is available with at least 3 layout variants
Text size has a clear increase/decrease control with no upper cap below standard mobile sizes
Editor offers a night/dark theme as a first-class option

title: Add more stickers / clipart / frames and consolidate downloads
description: Users want more (and cheaper or free) stickers, clipart, frames, and lens flares ("need to reduce price of sticker it's need to add more effect"), plus a single download surface to grab them all and a way to upload custom images as stickers. Some users cannot find purchased frames or clipart and want clearer recovery.
affected_component: Sticker / clipart / frame library and download surface
user_story: As a creator, I want a richer and more affordable sticker / clipart / frame catalog and a way to upload my own, so that I can decorate my photos without paying for every pack.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog gains at least 50 new stickers/frames per major release
User can upload custom images and use them as stickers
A single screen lists all available downloads and clearly marks free vs. paid
Restore-purchases flow recovers previously bought packs reliably
Free pack rotation is documented and visible in-app

title: Provide an option to roll back to the previous app version
description: Users repeatedly ask for the older version back ("old version be better but new update be not so better", "plz bring old version . new version suck man"). Specific regressions cited include lost sharpness and removed options. Reviews cluster around perceived loss of functionality after updates.
affected_component: App-versioning / rollback path
user_story: As a user dissatisfied with a recent update, I want a supported way to install or roll back to a previous app version, so that I am not stuck with regressions until a fix ships.
acceptance_criteria: App offers an explicit "classic" / legacy mode for the most-recent stable release
Documentation or in-app link explains how to install a previous APK with security caveats
Removed options (e.g., sharpness, layout choices) are restored as toggles
Release notes call out behavioral changes in advance
User-data format remains backward compatible across the rollback boundary

title: Add Hindi, Indonesian, Latin, and Urdu language support
description: Users in non-English markets ask for native-language support: "please add indonesian language", "add hindi font", "please add latin", and Urdu font support that was previously available is now missing. Users want both UI translations and text-tool font coverage.
affected_component: Localization (UI strings) and text-tool font coverage
user_story: As a non-English-speaking user, I want the app UI and text tools localized to my language with appropriate fonts, so that I can use the app comfortably in my native script.
acceptance_criteria: UI strings ship in at least Hindi, Indonesian, Latin, and Urdu in addition to existing languages
Text tool ships fonts that render Devanagari, Latin, and Arabic / Urdu scripts
Language switcher is reachable in 2 taps from the main settings screen
Custom-font import for the text tool from device storage is restored
App uses the device locale by default and falls back gracefully

title: Add a real lock screen with password and richer AppLock controls
description: Users want "an actual lockscreen that you need to put in a password", broader app coverage ("be great if we can select any <app> from application manager freely"), and to avoid stacking a second lock screen on top of the system lock. Passcode-reset behavior is also confusing.
affected_component: AppLock and lock-screen feature set
user_story: As a privacy-conscious user, I want a real lock screen with a password and the ability to lock any installed app, so that I can secure individual apps without doubling up on the system lock screen.
acceptance_criteria: User can enable a true lock screen requiring a password / pattern / biometric
AppLock can target any installed app, not a curated list
AppLock and the system lock screen do not stack into double-unlock by default
Passcode reset flow does not silently change the active passcode
Lock screen does not interfere with widgets, ads, or notifications by default

title: Add automatic background removal, color change, and eraser tools
description: Users want "automatic background clear feature", a way to change background and hair color ("how to change background colour and hair colour . plzz help me out"), and a text/magic-effect eraser. Several long-time customers note they have purchased many packs and are still missing this feature.
affected_component: Photo editor: background tools and selection / eraser
user_story: As a photo editor, I want one-tap background removal, color recoloring tools, and an eraser for overlays, so that I can do common compositing tasks without leaving the app.
acceptance_criteria: Editor exposes an "automatic background remove" action that produces a mask preview
Color-change tool can target background and hair regions independently
Magic-effect / overlay layers each get an eraser brush with adjustable size
Backgrounds gallery includes new themed sets each major release
Tools work on portrait images at standard mobile resolutions

title: Allow adding additional photos mid-edit and improve photo-edit workflow
description: Users want to add more photos during an in-progress edit ("i can't add photo during edit ! bakwaas app") and want richer photo-editing options comparable to desktop tools. Reviews skew positive overall (5-star dominant), suggesting a capability gap rather than a regression.
affected_component: Photo editor: multi-photo / collage workflow
user_story: As a casual photo editor, I want to add additional photos to an edit already in progress, so that I can iterate on collages and composites without restarting.
acceptance_criteria: Editor exposes an "Add photo" action that injects a new image into the current project
Newly added photos can be repositioned, resized, and layered
Adding a photo does not discard the current undo/redo history
Multi-photo edits export as a single output respecting the chosen resolution
Workflow parity with desktop-style options is documented in help

title: Restore one-tap save-to-gallery; separate Save and Share actions
description: Recent menu changes forced users into a Share-then-Save flow ("i have to shave private instead of save to my gallery", "why you change the save and share menu ? and no button for save only ?"). Users want a clear save-only button, a way to save without internet, and not to be kicked back to the profile mid-edit.
affected_component: Editor save / share menu and post-action navigation
user_story: As a casual editor, I want a one-tap "Save to gallery" action that does not require sharing or internet, so that I can finish edits and keep working without losing context.
acceptance_criteria: Editor exposes a dedicated Save button that writes to the device gallery only
Save works fully offline
After Save, the user remains in the editor session rather than being kicked to a profile page
Share is a separate action that can still be combined with Save when chosen
Default save destination is configurable in settings

title: Add brightness control, screenshot, antivirus, and customization options
description: Users tie a 5-star rating to a list of asks: brightness controller, notification toolbar editor, screenshot, antivirus, more wallpapers, and customization options ("please follow the buzz luncher . then i will give you <digit> star"). Others want the rate-app prompt to stop nagging, and the full-control screen to be optional.
affected_component: Launcher: feature-set additions and rating-prompt control
user_story: As a power user, I want built-in customization tools (brightness, screenshot, notification editor, wallpapers) and to control the launcher's permission prompts, so that I get a richer launcher without extra apps.
acceptance_criteria: Launcher exposes brightness, screenshot, and notification-toolbar controls in the quick panel
A wallpaper gallery with at least 30 curated options ships in-app
The full-control / accessibility prompt is optional and skippable without functional loss
The rate-app prompt does not reappear after the user submits a rating
Customization options are reachable from the home screen in 2 taps

title: Add more camera filters and restore the previous filter look
description: Users want more filters ("need more filter", "please bring more wow filter") and complain that the new update made filters look "more edit than before" ("latest one make the filter look more edit ... turn it back to the old version please"). Some specifically reference filters from competitor apps (Candy Camera, B612).
affected_component: Camera filters: catalog and visual style
user_story: As a casual selfie user, I want more natural-looking filters and the option to restore the older filter style, so that my photos do not look over-processed.
acceptance_criteria: Filter catalog adds at least 10 new filters with documented styles
A "Classic" filter option reproduces the pre-update look
Filters degrade gracefully on low-end cameras
Auto-flash and front-flash improvements ship alongside filter additions
Filter previews are visible without applying

title: Improve in-app help, tutorials, and UI clarity
description: Mixed cluster requesting better help and a clearer UI: questions that lack answers ("jus hv <digit> doubt dat be msgng option available in table or nt"), confusion between major UI versions ("the <digit>.<digit>.<digit> be nice menu display ... the <digit>.x.x. be illogical"), and slide gestures that hide content. Quality concern: heterogeneous theme; multiple sub-issues bundled.
affected_component: Help system, onboarding, and main navigation UI
user_story: As a new or returning user, I want clear help content and a consistent UI between versions, so that I can answer my own questions without writing reviews.
acceptance_criteria: An in-app help section answers the top 10 user questions with searchable text
Major UI changes between versions are explained in a one-time changelog overlay
Navigation does not require swipes that obscure key content
Tutorials are available for the most-used features and are dismissible
Help content is localized to all supported languages

title: Improve flashlight: full brightness, screen-off mode, background use
description: Users want a flashlight where they can turn the screen off ("a flashlight where you cant turn the screen off ?"), full brightness regardless of auto-brightness ("give option in set to enable full brightness"), the ability to use the flash while another app is open, and a quicker on-off without fully opening the app.
affected_component: Flashlight feature: brightness, screen state, background invocation
user_story: As someone who needs a flashlight in a hurry, I want a full-brightness mode that works with the screen off and from outside the app, so that I can use the torch without unlocking and keeping the screen on.
acceptance_criteria: Flashlight has a "screen off" toggle that turns off the display while the flash is on
A "full brightness" setting overrides auto-brightness while the flash is active
A quick-tile / widget allows toggling the flash without opening the main app
Flashlight remains available while other apps are foregrounded
Strobe and other modes do not regress from the current behavior

title: Editor improvements: more blend modes, magic edit, in-app tutorials
description: Users want a center alignment tool ("would be better if we have a center tool like phonto"), more blend modes ("add some more bland mod"), a magic-edit feature, free unlocked features, and an in-app tutorial. Skews positive (5-star dominant), so framed as enhancement.
affected_component: Photo editor: blend modes, alignment tools, magic edit, tutorials
user_story: As an enthusiast editor, I want richer blend modes, a center-alignment tool, magic edit, and an in-app tutorial, so that I can produce more sophisticated edits without external guides.
acceptance_criteria: Editor adds at least 5 new blend modes covering common compositing needs
A center-alignment guide is available while moving layers
A "magic edit" feature is documented and reachable in 2 taps
An in-app tutorial covers core workflows and is dismissible
Crash and lag rates during routine edit sessions improve in measurable benchmarks

title: Add toggle to disable UC News content and notifications inside the browser
description: Users want a clean browser experience and repeatedly request an option to fully turn off UC News content, notifications, and bundled content like 'sunny leone ka naya hot trailer'. Reviewers say 'browser is for surf net' and ask for the toggle that existed in older versions to be restored.
affected_component: UC Browser homepage / UC News integration / notification settings
user_story: As a UC Browser user, I want a single setting that disables UC News content, push notifications, and homepage news cards, so that I can use the app purely as a web browser without unwanted content.
acceptance_criteria: Settings screen exposes a 'Disable UC News' master toggle that hides news cards from the homepage when off
Toggling off UC News also suppresses all UC News push notifications without requiring OS-level blocking
Setting persists across app updates and device restarts
Users on the latest version can reach a state visually equivalent to the pre-news older versions referenced in reviews
An optional 'small window mode' / read mode is available for distraction-free browsing

title: Expand blur tools with auto background blur, defocus, and shape masks
description: Reviewers consistently praise the photo editor but request a richer blur toolset: 'automatic blur on camera', 'defocus feature in blur tab', 'free blur feature', 'shape blur option like circle', and 'auto background blur or change mode'. Currently the blur tab is perceived as too limited.
affected_component: Photo editor - Blur tool / Effects panel
user_story: As a photo editor user, I want a richer blur toolkit including automatic background blur, defocus, shape-masked blur, and a free-form blur brush, so that I can produce portrait-style and creative images without leaving the app.
acceptance_criteria: Blur tab exposes auto background blur using on-device subject segmentation
Defocus / lens-blur option with adjustable radius is available
Shape-mask blur supports at least circle, rectangle, and freehand selection
Free blur brush lets users paint blur on/off any region
All new blur modes work on photos imported from gallery and camera capture

title: Add granular controls to disable in-app reminders and notification cleaner pop-ups
description: Users describe the notifications as 'invasive', 'overwhelming', and 'obnoxious', and call out the irony that a notification-cleaner app is itself the loudest notifier. They want a way to choose whether they receive update reminders, optimization nags, and visual feedback such as 'alien spaceships'.
affected_component: Notification / reminder subsystem (in-app and push)
user_story: As a user of a system-utility app, I want fine-grained controls to disable update prompts, optimization reminders, and decorative pop-ups, so that I am not interrupted by the very tool that claims to clean notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Settings expose individual toggles for: update reminders, clean/optimize reminders, notification-cleaner pop-ups, and decorative animations
A single 'Run silently in background' master switch disables all non-critical notifications
Disabled notifications stay disabled across app updates
No reminder reappears within 24 hours after the user dismisses it
Help text explains what each toggle suppresses

title: Add in-document text search, bookmarks, and tabbed PDF library
description: PDF reader users say 'this app couldn't search a word present in pdf', request a 'bookmark tool' so they can 'quickly and easily find those annotations', and want 'tabs' to switch between PDFs plus a 'book library / pdf library / shelve feature' so they don't have to re-browse the file system each time.
affected_component: PDF reader - search, bookmark, and library/tabs
user_story: As a PDF reader user, I want to search text inside open documents, bookmark annotations, and switch between recently opened PDFs in tabs from a persistent library, so that I can navigate large documents as quickly as I do on a PC.
acceptance_criteria: Long-press on a word inside a PDF surfaces 'Find in document' and 'Web search' actions
Bookmarks panel lists every annotation with page number and jumps to it on tap
Imported PDFs persist in a library/shelf view and do not require re-browsing the file system
Top tab bar lets users switch between recently opened PDFs without going back to the file picker
Search returns at least as many hits as a desktop client for the same query

title: Add scheduled background virus scans and pre-install app scanning
description: Users want this antivirus to behave like 'norton anti virus', requesting 'scan option before download an app', 'auto scan feature for virus at given specific time' with 'detail report', and a way to 'introduce background antivirus scan'. They also ask for unification of the vendor's separate AV products.
affected_component: Antivirus engine - scheduling, install-time hooks, reporting
user_story: As a security-conscious user, I want the antivirus to scan apps automatically before they install, run scheduled background scans at times I choose, and produce a detailed report, so that I get protection comparable to mainstream desktop AV products.
acceptance_criteria: User can schedule recurring scans (daily/weekly + time of day) that run silently in the background
Newly downloaded APKs are scanned automatically before install completes
Each scan produces a detailed report listing files inspected, threats found, and actions taken
Scheduled and pre-install scans run without requiring the app to be foregrounded
Settings clearly indicate when the next scheduled scan will occur

title: Add paint-bucket fill, restore layers, and expand brush library in Draw mode
description: Drawing-mode users repeatedly ask 'why is there not a paint bucket tool', 'add fill tool so we can colour one object without brush just one tap', report 'the layer is missing in new update', and request 'new brushes' and 'draw measure option'. The feature gap is concrete and well-scoped.
affected_component: Photo editor - Draw / Sketch mode (brush, fill, layers)
user_story: As a digital artist using Draw mode, I want a paint-bucket fill tool, restored layer support, and an expanded brush library, so that I can produce flat-color illustrations and complex compositions without switching apps.
acceptance_criteria: Paint-bucket tool fills any closed region with one tap and respects existing layer/object boundaries
Layer panel is restored with at least add, delete, reorder, opacity, and merge actions
Brush library adds at least 5 new brush presets (e.g. ink, color pencil, marker)
Optional 'draw measure / grid' overlay assists freehand drawing from reference
All new tools are reachable from the existing Draw icon without nesting more than one menu deep

title: Restore Magic Effects entry point that disappeared after update
description: Multiple users say they 'updated to get latest update like magic efect' but 'after update didn't find magic effect which should be next to tool option'. They explicitly ask 'why new magic effect won't show?' and want a tutorial. The Magic Effects feature exists conceptually but its UI entry point is missing or undiscoverable.
affected_component: Photo editor - Effects/Tools menu (Magic Effect entry)
user_story: As a photo editor user who updated to the latest version, I want the Magic Effects feature to be visibly available next to the Tools option with optional in-app guidance, so that I can use the headline feature that motivated my update.
acceptance_criteria: Magic Effect button is visible next to the Tools option in the editor on all supported devices after update
Tapping the Magic Effect button opens the effects gallery within 2 seconds
First-time users are offered a short in-app tutorial / sample video for adding magic effects
Magic Effects work without forcing additional downloads or sign-ups
Telemetry confirms Magic Effect entry-point impressions match prior version after rollout

title: Expand built-in feature catalog and broaden device/use-case coverage
description: Reviews are scattered ('add more features like in built <app>', 'can u make <app> for motorcycle user', 'most wanted <app> for <app>') but consistently ask for additional in-app features and broader usage scenarios beyond the current core. Theme is mixed but the underlying request is for a richer feature catalog.
affected_component: Core feature catalog / app navigation
user_story: As a power user, I want the app to expose additional built-in features and support more use-cases (e.g., motorcycle riders, secondary apps), so that I can use one app instead of installing several specialized ones.
acceptance_criteria: Product roadmap publicly tracks the top 5 most-requested features from review-mining
At least one new mode/profile is added to cover non-default user segments raised in reviews (e.g., motorcycle)
Feature list opens in under 2 seconds (addresses 'list opens up a bit slowly')
New features are discoverable via in-app What's New screen
User feedback channel is in-app and lets users vote on requested features

title: Add password reset, account recovery, and optional registration flows
description: Users describe the app as 'a stupid application with no option to reset password' and report being asked for an email at recovery time that was never collected at sign-up. Others complain about 'mandatory registration' with no clear sign-in prompt and no recovery path if they forget username/password. The login UX is missing core account features.
affected_component: Authentication - account creation, password reset, account recovery
user_story: As a user who has forgotten my credentials or who is new to the app, I want a clear sign-in prompt, a working password-reset flow, and an account recovery path, so that I do not lose access to my data.
acceptance_criteria: Password reset is available via email AND phone number (at least one of which the user provided at sign-up)
Reset flow works for accounts that did not provide an email at registration (use phone OTP)
Login screen shows both 'Sign in' and 'Sign up' clearly and detects existing accounts on the device
Forgotten-username recovery flow exists and uses phone number as identifier
E-signature / government-ID verification options match desktop parity for the relevant region

title: Allow users to remove or replace the app watermark with their own logo
description: Users report the imposed watermark 'really just ruins the photo', recall earlier versions where it was optional, and ask to 'add my own name's watermark' or remove it entirely. Reviews repeat phrases like 'put an annoying watermark on picture' and 'please remove the watermark'.
affected_component: Image export / Save pipeline - watermark
user_story: As a photo editor user, I want to disable the default app watermark or replace it with my own logo/name, so that exported photos look professional and personally branded.
acceptance_criteria: Settings exposes a 'Watermark' section with options: Off / Default app watermark / Custom
Custom watermark accepts user-supplied text or PNG logo with adjustable position and opacity
Setting applies to all save and share paths (gallery, share sheet, square-fit export)
Choice is remembered across sessions
Users can preview the watermark before final export

title: Photo quality degraded after edit/save, output limited to 480p
description: Users report saved photos are 'very low quality and fully blurred', that 'colors change' between preview and capture, and that the unpaid version 'only saves 480p'. This violates the speed/responsiveness/output-fidelity expectations of an image editor and produces visibly degraded artifacts compared to the on-screen preview.
affected_component: Image capture and save pipeline / output encoder
expected_behavior: Saved/exported images preserve the resolution and color fidelity shown in the editor preview, and the app exposes an HD save option.
actual_behavior: Saved images are blurry, color-shifted, and capped at 480p in the free tier; cutting large photos crashes the app with 'unfortunately stopped'.

title: In-app ads drain battery and make the app unusable on cellular
description: Reviewers report 'ads everywhere drain your battery fast' and that video ads make the app 'unusable when on cell service and very time consuming when on wifi'. The fake disable-ads button 'merely switches itself back on'. The ad surface is not just intrusive but causes measurable battery and bandwidth performance regressions.
affected_component: Ad subsystem / network and power consumption
expected_behavior: Ad load and rendering should not measurably degrade battery life or block primary app workflows on cellular connections.
actual_behavior: Continuous and video ads drain battery faster than the rest of the app combined, saturate cellular bandwidth, and cannot be reliably disabled.

title: App is a heavy battery drainer when running in background
description: Users report 'eats up all your battery when running', 'battery fast drain', 'makes my battery die three times faster', and call the app a 'battery eater'. The persistent notifications and background activity correlate with the drain.
affected_component: Background services / persistent notification / wake-lock usage
expected_behavior: Background battery consumption should be a small fraction of foreground use and comparable to peer apps; the user can run the app passively without noticeable battery impact.
actual_behavior: Battery drains 2-3x faster after install; persistent notifications keep services alive and wake-locks prevent doze.

title: App slows down host device, freezes screen, and prevents unlock
description: Users say the app 'makes my phone so slow', 'cause games to shut down', 'slows my phone down way too much and makes it almost impossible to unlock it while charging', and 'freezes my screen'. The performance impact is system-wide rather than confined to the app.
affected_component: Background services / system resource consumption (CPU, RAM)
expected_behavior: The app should run within a constrained background CPU/RAM budget and never block UI responsiveness, lock-screen unlock, or other foreground apps.
actual_behavior: The app monopolizes CPU and RAM, freezes screens on tablets, makes other apps shut down, and blocks the unlock gesture while the device is charging.

title: GPS signal loss and inaccurate ETA cause wrong driver assignment
description: Riders report 'always wrong directions', 'GPS signal loss', 'driver assigned very far away', and 'map shows car around but books driver miles away'. ETAs deviate strongly from actual arrival, and pickup directions require manual phone calls. This is a GPS/routing responsiveness and accuracy regression.
affected_component: GPS / map / driver-matching service
expected_behavior: App acquires and maintains GPS lock during booking, assigns the nearest available driver, and the displayed ETA matches actual arrival within a small margin.
actual_behavior: GPS frequently reports 'signal loss', a far-away driver is assigned even when nearby drivers are visible on the map, ETAs underestimate by minutes, and pickup directions are wrong.

title: Battery drain regression after latest update; battery saver itself drains battery
description: Users state 'after latest update the battery drain is horrible', that the bundled battery saver 'drains while running', and that frequent restarts of the app are flagged by the OS as causing extra drain. The drain regression appeared with a specific update.
affected_component: Background battery-saver service / app self-restart loop
expected_behavior: Updates should not regress battery characteristics; the battery saver should reduce, not increase, device power consumption.
actual_behavior: Post-update, the app frequently self-restarts, holds wake-locks while idle, and is reported by the OS as one of the top battery consumers.

title: Overall app speed is too slow; common operations feel sluggish
description: Reviews are short and unanimous: 'it is very slow', 'often very slow', 'too slow', 'not fast enough'. Users do not single out a feature - they perceive baseline interaction speed as below expectations.
affected_component: Core app loop / UI responsiveness
expected_behavior: Common interactions (open, navigate, primary action) should complete within ~1 second on mid-tier devices.
actual_behavior: Users perceive global sluggishness across primary flows, severe enough that 'slow' is the dominant single-word review.

title: App consumes excessive storage and background data despite cleaner claims
description: Users report the cleaner app itself 'takes way too much space', 'uses tons of background data even if you turn it off (.7GB last month)', and the storage numbers it reports do not match the OS. Reviews note 'this also happens to even pictures I delete with this tool'.
affected_component: Storage usage / background data / cleaner reporting accuracy
expected_behavior: A cleaner/utility app should occupy a small footprint, respect background-data toggles, and report storage figures consistent with the OS.
actual_behavior: The app's own footprint and background data usage exceed the average of the apps it claims to clean; data toggles are not honoured; reported free space disagrees with system settings.

title: Download speed is throttled, especially when device screen is locked
description: Users report 'too slow to download', 'download speed is very slow', and specifically 'why download speed decreases to 2KB/s when I lock my mobile'. Throughput drops well below expected and ad-blocker integrations also fail.
affected_component: Downloader engine / background scheduling
expected_behavior: Downloads should saturate available network bandwidth and continue at full speed when the device screen is locked.
actual_behavior: Downloads stall or drop to ~2KB/s when the screen is locked and remain slow even on fast networks; some sites cannot be opened due to high RAM use.

title: Phone overheats and battery drains while cooler/optimizer app is running
description: Users say the phone 'almost over heats' with this app installed, that 'battery drains fast and device heats up due to this app', and that uninstalling restores normal thermals. Ironically, the app markets itself as a cooler/optimizer.
affected_component: Background optimizer / wake-lock and CPU usage
expected_behavior: A device-cooler/optimizer should reduce, not increase, CPU load and thermal output; uninstalling should not be required to keep the device cool.
actual_behavior: The app keeps services running, holds CPU wakelocks, and produces sustained heat that subsides only after uninstall.

title: App startup and asset loading are excessively slow
description: Users report 'takes very long time to open', 'pathetically slow', 'collage grids take a lifetime to load' on devices where prior versions were fast. Cold start and asset-load times have regressed against older versions.
affected_component: App startup / collage grid asset loading
expected_behavior: Cold start completes in under 3 seconds and primary assets such as collage grids load within 1-2 seconds on typical devices.
actual_behavior: Cold start and grid loading take many seconds, with newer versions slower than older ones referenced in the same reviews.

title: Antivirus app itself consumes huge RAM, drains battery, and slows device
description: Users report the antivirus 'consumes huge RAM', 'bogs down your device', and 'makes phone process slower than molasses in January'. The protective tool degrades device performance more than the threats it claims to remove.
affected_component: Antivirus engine - background scanner / memory footprint
expected_behavior: Antivirus should run with a modest memory and CPU footprint and not noticeably degrade overall device responsiveness.
actual_behavior: Background scanning consumes large amounts of RAM, slows down the entire device, and drains battery; ads compound the load.

title: Phone hangs and self-restarts after installing the app
description: Users repeatedly state 'my phone hangs', 'gets hung after previous update on Samsung Galaxy Grand Prime', 'hangs a lot... and self-restarts in the middle of editing'. The hang affects devices with otherwise sufficient RAM.
affected_component: Main thread / memory management - causes system-wide hang
expected_behavior: App should not hang the host device or trigger self-restart; main-thread work should be bounded so the OS does not throw ANRs.
actual_behavior: The app frequently freezes the device for seconds at a time, especially after the latest update, and restarts itself mid-task.

title: App runs slowly even on flagship phones; service degraded versus prior months
description: Users describe a 'slowish experience on a flagship phone' with 'lots of progress bars' and 'service degraded over the past months'. On HTC Desire and Note devices, camera operations and map return-to-screen are sluggish or broken after the latest update.
affected_component: Map / camera tab and overall UI responsiveness
expected_behavior: App should match or exceed prior-version responsiveness; map should return to the foreground after a call, and camera should run without notable lag.
actual_behavior: Post-update, camera is slow, map does not return to screen after a call (critical for hands-free driving), and the experience lags even on flagships.

title: Battery-booster app actually drops battery from full to near-empty within hours
description: Users report 'within X hours battery drained from 100 to low', '<app> uses huge percent of battery in background', and that the app 'says it boosts energy but drops 100->low in minutes'. The app claims to boost battery yet measurably worsens battery life.
affected_component: Battery-booster background service
expected_behavior: A battery-booster claims should be supported by measurable improvement; idle background drain should be near zero.
actual_behavior: App is reported by Android battery stats as a top consumer; battery drops dramatically within hours of install, the opposite of advertised behavior.

title: Pervasive UI lag during routine browsing and refresh
description: Reviews are mostly short and consistent: 'laggy', 'laggy and slow', 'a bit laggy while browsing files', 'delayed refresh', 'makes things even more laggy'. The app introduces visible UI jank during everyday browsing.
affected_component: File browser / list refresh and UI thread
expected_behavior: List scrolling and refresh should be smooth at 60fps on supported devices, with no perceptible delay between user input and UI response.
actual_behavior: Users perceive consistent lag while browsing files and during refresh; some users report new content appears after a delay.

title: New version is slower and more memory-hungry than prior versions
description: Users report 'new update very slow and takes more RAM than older', 'after update wait time is too long', 'new version very slow loading', 'old version was very good'. Multiple users explicitly downgrade or ask for the prior version back.
affected_component: App startup / update regression - increased memory and load time
expected_behavior: New app versions should not regress against prior versions on memory footprint, cold-start time, or wait-time for primary tasks.
actual_behavior: The latest update is markedly slower, uses more RAM, and lengthens wait times compared to the previous version on the same device.

title: Persistent notification service drains battery and consumes excess CPU
description: Users report 'when I uninstalled this app my battery life got much better', 'app drains my battery and consumes too much CPU', 'always running in background... annoying ucmusic notification'. The persistent notification subsystem is the proximate cause of the battery/CPU regression.
affected_component: Persistent notification service / news feed background sync
expected_behavior: Notification service should respect the user's notification toggles and consume minimal CPU/battery when idle.
actual_behavior: Even with notifications turned off, the service keeps running, sends notifications, and is the largest battery/CPU consumer on the device.

title: App freezes the device for extended periods, especially during WiFi disconnect or step counting
description: Users report 'freezes up my phone, slow to access my apps', 'freezes when I hit the step button on Pixel XL', and that on a Galaxy S6 the app froze for over an hour after WiFi disconnect, requiring the user to wait for the battery to die. Freezes are device-wide and recovery requires force-stop or worse.
affected_component: Step counter / WiFi state-change handling - main-thread freeze
expected_behavior: App should not freeze on WiFi disconnect or step-button taps; the OS should never need to be force-rebooted to recover.
actual_behavior: Long freezes (minutes to over an hour) occur on specific events (WiFi disconnect, step button), blocking other apps and unlock.

title: Content load is consistently slow; download speed perceived as worst-in-class
description: Users say 'takes much time to load and download speed is worst', 'slow loading - please make it fast', 'takes too much time to load'. The user-facing load time blocks usage and is consistently flagged as a performance defect.
affected_component: Content load / server fetch path
expected_behavior: Primary content should load within a few seconds on typical broadband and mobile connections.
actual_behavior: Loading stalls for many seconds on the same network where peer apps load quickly; users describe it as 'pathetically slow'.

title: News feed surfaces clickbait, ignores topic preferences, and reinstalls itself
description: Users complain the news content is 'click bait... no real news, just gossip column', that they 'cannot pick more than X topics', and that the app 'keeps coming back' after uninstall. The system fails to give users meaningful control over their content. This violates user control and freedom.
affected_component: News feed - topic selection, push notifications, install lifecycle

title: Aggressive interstitial ads and forced sign-in interrupt user workflows
description: Users describe 'intrusive ads', being 'forced to sign in', and ads 'pushed every day until that's all there is'. Even paying users 'see ads after paying for ad-free subscription'. The app intrudes on user workflow and removes the user's sense of being in control. Violates user control and freedom plus error prevention.
affected_component: Ad placement / sign-in gating / subscription enforcement

title: Fare and ETA shown to riders does not match actual experience, eroding trust
description: Riders report 'inaccurate price calculation - Uber calculates fare with longest and irrelevant routes', 'fare changes every X minutes and you are not guaranteed', and 'driver cancels and we have to bear the fare'. The displayed price/ETA does not reflect what actually happens. This violates the visibility-of-system-status heuristic - the system status shown to the user is not honest.
affected_component: Fare estimator / ride status / cancellation policy display

title: Pervasive ads with no opt-out clutter the interface
description: Users report 'too many ads', ads being 'basically nothing but spam', and ask 'is there a way you don't have to see or can ignore all ads'. The interface is dominated by promotional content the user cannot control or hide. Violates aesthetic and minimalist design.
affected_component: Ad placement / UI density

title: Cluttered antivirus UI mixes useful protection with bloat and unclear claims
description: Mixed-rating cluster: many praise virus removal and speed gains, but others say 'haven't noticed any improvement in performance and way too much clutter' and 'puts tons of spyware in my phone'. Users cannot easily separate genuine protection from upsell clutter. Violates aesthetic and minimalist design plus match between system and real world.
affected_component: Antivirus UI - main dashboard and feature surface

title: Photo editor is praised for ease of use; preserve simple direct-edit flow
