description: Highly positive cluster: users say 'really easy and fun to use', 'best ability of any app I have', 'edit all your photos in one app', 'easy to use'. Recommendation is to preserve the recognition-over-recall, low-friction flow that makes the editor accessible to non-experts.
affected_component: Photo editor - main edit flow / discoverability of tools

title: Navigation app fails silently without data and does not announce upcoming exits
description: Users say 'as soon as you hit an area without data the program will be aborted leaving you without any guidance' and 'doesn't even say which exit yours is - just has its name on the bottom of the screen'. Critical guidance is silent or aborts. Violates visibility-of-system-status: the user has no idea what is going on at decision moments.
affected_component: Turn-by-turn navigation - offline failure mode and exit announcements

title: Interface praised as 'easy', 'neat', and 'simple to use'; preserve consistency
description: Positive-leaning cluster: 'best user interface', 'easy to use and helps organize', 'fast and easy to use'. One outlier 'not user friendly'. Goal is to preserve current consistency and standards while addressing the small minority who find specific flows non-friendly.
affected_component: Overall app UI / navigation consistency

title: Update silently installs lock-screen ad overlay disguised as 'smart charging' feature
description: Users state 'app installed an ad overlay on my lock screen', 'app takes over the lock screen without my permission - shoves ads down my throat', and 'deceptive lock screen adware posing as smartcharging feature'. The user's lock screen is appropriated without informed consent. Severe violation of user control and freedom.
affected_component: Lock-screen overlay / smartcharging feature / consent prompt

title: Pop-ups demand 5-star ratings and ads cannot be disabled even briefly
description: Users say 'in-ad pop-up tells me to rate 5 star - that is going to cost you stars', 'unwanted pop-up adds I didn't agree to', 'ads cannot be disabled and show up once when I open it'. The app coerces ratings and removes user control over notifications. Violates user control and freedom.
affected_component: In-app rating prompt / ad disable controls

title: Update forces social-network sign-in and removes simple save-to-gallery flow
description: Users say 'turned a perfect app into a social network', 'asks me to register after the latest update', 'I can't even save to my gallery anymore - forced to share photos to the online community'. The previously simple save flow now requires sign-in and public sharing. Violates user control and freedom and match-between-system-and-real-world (people expect a photo editor to save photos).
affected_component: Save / share flow / sign-in gating

title: Collage maker is praised for ease and variety; reinforce recognition-based design
description: Strongly positive cluster: 'so easy to use and you'll enjoy making collages', 'best app for making collage', 'easy to use and works with other editing apps'. Some users report support helped them recover when feature changed (remix-only mode). Recognition-over-recall design supports broad adoption.
affected_component: Collage maker - layout selection and edit flow

title: Video editing tools are praised; expand format support without harming flow
description: Mostly positive: users 'enjoy editing video with no hassle', 'can make movies and short films', 'best to edit video'. One user notes 'cant edit MOV video using this app' and another initially confused HD-save absence with a bug until support clarified. Flexibility and minor format support are the next steps.
affected_component: Video editor - import/export format support and HD save discoverability

title: Frequent layout overhauls break user habits and remove labeled controls
description: Users say 'buttons that used to be labelled and easy to understand have been changed', 'layout changes too frequently - we don't like the constant change', 'difficult to use after update'. Repeated layout churn breaks consistency and forces users to rebuild mental models.
affected_component: App-wide layout / button labeling / ordering

title: Themes and wallpapers change device settings without clear user consent
description: Users report 'tells you to put a wallpaper of their choice not yours', 'starts controlling your phone like a 3rd party watching what you have', 'changed all my wallpaper - don't waste your time'. Theme installation alters phone state in ways users did not authorize. Violates user control and freedom.
affected_component: Theme/wallpaper installer / system-settings integration

title: Photo editor praised as easy and fun; surface red-eye removal for discoverability
description: Strongly positive cluster: 'easy to use', 'fun to edit photos', 'great to edit and be creative'. One concrete usability gap: 'I don't see the tool to remove red eye'. Improve recognition-over-recall by surfacing existing tools in the primary tool grid.
affected_component: Photo editor - tool grid / red-eye tool discoverability

title: App hangs on white screen and fails to load on Samsung Galaxy S6/S7 and Xiaomi Redmi 3S
description: Users on multiple Samsung Galaxy models (S4, S6, S7, S7 Edge) and Xiaomi Redmi 3S report the app 'hangs with blank white screen', 'cannot uninstall', 'download stops at X%', and 'cannot open since the update - just a white screen'. Behavior is device/OS-specific, occurs after install or post-update, and reproduces across multiple users.
affected_component: App launch / initial render / map download (device-specific)
expected_behavior: App should launch and render its first screen on Samsung Galaxy S4/S6/S7/S7 Edge and Xiaomi Redmi 3S running Android 6.x and above.
actual_behavior: After install or update, app shows a persistent blank white screen, cannot load any content, cannot be uninstalled (Xiaomi), or fails map downloads at a fixed percentage.

title: Camera and editor regressions on Samsung Galaxy S4 mini, S5, S7, and Tab Pro after recent update
description: Users on specific Samsung Galaxy hardware (S4 mini, S5, S7 active, Galaxy Pro tablet) report post-update issues: 'phone restarts every time I take a picture', 'aspect ratio gets messed up', 'freezes when I try to add text', 'camera fuzzy on crisp black/white', 'dash cam feature does not work on Samsung Galaxy S7'. MX Player on Marshmallow has a brightness bug. Issues correlate with specific device + OS update combinations.
affected_component: Camera capture / editor draw mode / dash-cam recording (device + OS-specific)
expected_behavior: Camera, photo editor (with text/draw), and dash-cam features should work consistently on Samsung Galaxy S4 mini, S5, S7 active, and Galaxy Tab Pro running Android 6.x (Marshmallow) and above.
actual_behavior: Phone restarts when taking a picture (S4 mini), brightness control broken on Marshmallow, draw portion inaccessible (Galaxy Pro tablet), text-add freezes (S5), camera focus broken on B/W (S7 active), dash cam does not record (S7).

title: App Lock and fingerprint unlock fail on multiple Samsung Galaxy models after software updates
description: Users report 'app lock not working in Samsung Galaxy S4', 'Galaxy S5 says device is not compatible with app lock', 'after software update on Galaxy A5 fingerprint app lock not working', and 'on new Galaxy S6 incoming-call lock password not working'. The Samsung S8 user reports the same after a software update. App-lock and fingerprint integrations are broken across the Galaxy lineup post-update.
affected_component: App Lock / fingerprint authentication / incoming-call lock
expected_behavior: App Lock and fingerprint-based unlock should work on Samsung Galaxy S4, S5, S6, S8, and A5 across recent software updates, including incoming-call lock.
actual_behavior: Galaxy S4 / S5 are flagged as incompatible; Galaxy A5 fingerprint lock stops working after software update even after re-enrolling fingerprints; Galaxy S6 incoming-call lock password stops working; Galaxy S8 stops locking incoming calls.

affected_os: Samsung software update (Android, version unspecified by reviewers)

title: 'Internal error' on sign-in blocks Samsung Galaxy S5/S7/Tab users, including after reinstall
description: Users say 'cannot sign in on Samsung Galaxy S5 - many S5 owners are experiencing the same issue', 'cannot sign in on Galaxy S7 Edge - tried uninstalling and reinstalling many times', 'after upgrade cannot log in at all even after factory reset on Galaxy S Tab', 'just got Galaxy S7 and app won't allow sign in - keeps saying internal error - works fine on old S4 - permissions not set'. Issue is specific to Samsung Galaxy S5/S7/Tab and surfaces as a generic 'internal error'.
affected_component: Authentication / sign-in service - device-permission handling on Samsung Galaxy S5/S7/Tab
expected_behavior: Users should be able to sign in on Samsung Galaxy S5, S7, S7 Edge, and S Tab without an 'internal error' loop, and required permissions should be requested automatically.
actual_behavior: Sign-in repeatedly returns 'internal error - please restart the app' on Galaxy S5, S7, S7 Edge, and S Tab; reinstall and factory reset do not help; root cause appears to be permissions not being requested at install time.

affected_os: Android (recent Samsung software upgrade, version unspecified)
